newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka shares are expected to face more profit taking by retail investors on Tuesday which, brokers said, might result in mixed trading.

"The market may witness both buying and selling. A number of blue-chip shares may fall on profit taking which gained for the last several sessions," said broker Shakil Rizvi. Brokers said scrips in engineering, food and pharmaceutical sectors might drop on selling.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index gained 2.6 points or 0.25 percent to 1,005.57 on turnover of 57.1 million taka on Monday. -- Dhaka newsroom +880-2-506363
